courses.title: MongoDB Essentials
courses.summary: This comprehensive training track guides participants from the core fundamentals of MongoDB to advanced application development techniques. Designed to bridge the gap between foundational knowledge and production-level optimization, this session covers everything from the document model and basic CRUD operations to complex aggregation pipelines, data modeling, and full-text search.

slides.heading: Program Overview
slides.body: By the end of this training, participants will have the practical skills necessary to design, build, and optimize high-performance applications using MongoDB.

courses.title: Data Modeling in MongoDB
courses.summary: This targeted training session focuses on the art and science of designing highly efficient schemas tailored to diverse database workloads. Participants will move beyond traditional relational normalization to master document-based data modeling, applying proven design patterns while actively identifying and avoiding performance-killing anti-patterns.

slides.heading: Program Overview
slides.body: By the end of this session, you will possess the architectural frameworks and best practices needed to design high-performance MongoDB schemas for real-world applications.

courses.title: MongoDB Atlas for Admins
courses.summary: This comprehensive training session covers the essentials of administering MongoDB deployments on MongoDB Atlas, MongoDB's fully managed cloud database service. Participants will gain hands-on experience navigating the Atlas platform, automating workflows, and ensuring database resilience and efficiency.

slides.heading: Program Overview
slides.body: By the end of this session, you will possess the practical skills required to confidently deploy, secure, and manage high-performing MongoDB Atlas environments.

courses.title: Self-Managed MongoDB for Admins
courses.summary: This comprehensive training track focuses on the architectural components, production deployment strategies, and administrative practices required to run MongoDB at scale. Participants will dive deep into database internals, high availability configurations, horizontal scaling, and the day-to-day operational tasks necessary to ensure a stable, secure, and highly reliable database environment.

slides.heading: Program Overview
slides.body: By the end of this training, participants will have the expertise to confidently manage, monitor, tune, and protect production-grade MongoDB deployments.

courses.title: AI Masterclass
courses.summary: The MongoDB Masterclass is an accelerated, high-intensity two-day training program designed to equip technical teams with practical, high-impact MongoDB skills. Moving rapidly from core data manipulation to cutting-edge AI applications, this course bridges the gap between traditional database operations and next-generation intelligent application development.

slides.heading: Program Overview
slides.body: By the end of this masterclass, participants will know how to optimize data workflows, build sophisticated search experiences, and integrate MongoDB as a core component of modern AI and LLM orchestration.

courses.title: MongoDB Security Masterclass
courses.summary: This advanced masterclass delivers a focused, hands-on exploration of the security capabilities required to protect modern MongoDB deployments. Participants will learn how to implement strong authentication, enforce role-based access control, secure data in transit, at rest, and in use, and apply network security controls to reduce risk across enterprise environments.

slides.heading: Program Overview
slides.body: By the end of this session, participants will be able to design and operationalize robust security architectures for MongoDB, including modern encryption approaches such as CSFLE and Queryable Encryption, enabling them to meet enterprise security requirements with confidence.
